jump.title: Unusual year-on-year change
jump.text: The line moved far more than comparable lines (same budget type and economic category) normally do.

revision.title: Restated after publication
revision.text: The Treasury later published a materially different figure for the same line and year.

new_line.title: Line appears from nothing
new_line.text: A spending line with no spend the year before carries a large amount.

closed_line.title: Line vanishes
closed_line.text: A large spending line falls to nothing the following year.

sign_flip.title: Switches between spend and income
sign_flip.text: The net figure changes sign, e.g. from net spending to net receipt.

identical.title: Identical to the pound-thousand two years running
identical.text: Real outturn almost never repeats exactly; this can indicate a budget carried over rather than measured.

round.title: Exactly round amount
round.text: An outturn that is an exact whole number of £ millions is unusual in accrued accounts.

trend.title: Sustained rapid growth
trend.text: Four consecutive annual increases at a high compound rate.

function_jump.title: Unusual change in a function total
function_jump.text: A function (health, defence...) moved far more than its own history suggests.
